trap-superlative.notes: STRUCTURAL FINDINGS (report only). (1) A REFUTABLE STATEMENT behind the Lean sibling's sorry. QOU/AlgebraicSubstrate/JointGaloisBraidFigure8.lean closes with 'theorem kappa_commutes_bar (D : DisjointTensorCell) (p) : D.barTensor (D.kappa p) = D.kappa (D.barTensor p) := by sorry', whose docstring calls it 'a non-false, non-trivial claim'. As stated it quantifies over EVERY DisjointTensorCell with no hypothesis tying kappa to barF, and it is false: take Factor := Bool, barF := not, kappa := fun p => (p.2, true); then barTensor (kappa p) = (not p.2, false) but kappa (barTensor p) = (not p.2, true). So the sorry cannot be discharged as written - the missing bar-invariance hypothesis on kappa has to be added to the structure. The rest of the file is sound (Figure8SelfConjugateCell carries genuine hypotheses A and B; bar_commutes_gen and figure_8_joint_action are derived by rewriting and induction, no self-assumption). (2) Minor: Step 3 restricts 'D(conj z) = -D(z)' to z on the unit circle; the Bloch-Wigner identity holds for all z in C, so the restriction is unnecessary (harmless here, since zeta_6 is on the circle).
